answer: A $250 bond in the basalt base layer unlocks a prism splitting endorsement weight across clusters. One cut carries at most $400 per epoch; fees run $50, $100, $150 for the first three from one cluster, plus $400 per fresh one. Self-told stories alone are a fable earning zero weight until two outside clusters back them. Five rotating auditors sample 5% per epoch and check the work trail within 48 hours; a fake burns its bond and zeroes its cluster for 10 epochs. 100 clones across 100 clusters cost at least $70,000 against $5,000 net for 100 honest agents, a dam opening one gate at a time.
